question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Ravenous
solution: The correct answer is '**Starved**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Ravenous**' is '**Starved**'. • **Ravenous**: very hungry. (बहुत भूखा; मरभुक्‍खा) • *Example: She realized that she had eaten nothing since leaving home, and she was **ravenous**.* • **Starved**: to suffer or die because you do not have enough food to eat; to make somebody/something suffer or die in this way. (भूखा रहने के कारण कष्‍ट पाना या मर जाना, भूखा मरना; किसी को भूखा रखकर कष्‍ट देना या मार देना, भूखा मारना) • *Example: to **starve** to death...* **Correct Answer:__** *Starved.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Content**: happy or satisfied with what you have or do. (संतुष्‍ट) • **Satiated**: to completely satisfy a desire or need. (किसी इच्छा, ज़रूरत या भूख को पूरी तरह शांत करना; पूर्णतया संतुष्ट करना, तृप्त करना) • **Full**: holding or containing as much or as many as possible. (जितना भरा जा सके उतना भरा हुआ, पूरा भरा) 31:Tcb6, The correct answer is **'His boss gives him proper guidance'.**
